blocks.text: Notes that also apply here are written up once, on these pages:

items.t: Find Condos Priced Under $500K – Great for First-Time Buyers

faq.a: The cap sits above the middle of the combined attached market: the Mission Condos & Townhomes median sale price was $430,000 in September 2026 — $370,000 below the cap — though that median mixes townhomes with condos and swung from $642,500 in August 2026 on small sold counts, so treat it as context for where the cap sits, not as the price of a typical condo (SnapStats, September 2026)
faq.q: Does the $800K cap cover the typical Mission condo?

faq.a: By September 2026 inventory, the urban "Mission" sub-area held 104 Condos & Townhomes listings, Mission West 8 and Hemlock 9, out of 122 Mission-wide, and the rural sub-areas held almost none — those are combined condo-and-townhome inventory counts, not counts of condos under the cap (SnapStats, September 2026)
faq.q: Where does Mission's attached stock actually sit?

faq.a: SD75 Mission Public Schools; catchments are address-based — at the downtown sample address used here (7466 Welton St) the locator gives École Mission Central Elementary, Heritage Park Middle School and Mission Senior Secondary; SD75 runs a middle tier (Grades 7–9), and any specific condo address should be confirmed with SD75's School Locator Tool.
faq.q: Which school district serves Mission, and how are catchments set?
